articles.title: Repsol warns 90% of crude supplies may not meet EU methane rules
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Repsol SA said Thursday that approximately 90% of its crude oil supplies are expected to fall short of new European Union methane requirements set to begin in January. The Spanish energy company's Deputy Chief Executive Officer Luis Cabra said the firm continues to sign crude supply contracts even when suppliers refuse to provide information required under the regulation.
